translations.web: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
translations.bsb: Indeed, the evil man is spared from the day of calamity, delivered from the day of wrath.
translations.kjv: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
translations.asv: That the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity? That they are led forth to the day of wrath?
